english.note: Use this when emphasizing brutal, destructive cruelty, especially in violence or the conduct of a ruler or group.

examples.english: This regime is vicious in its rule and shows no mercy to its opponents.
examples.traditional: 呢個政權統治手段殘暴，對反對者毫不留情。
